shipped.title: michaelmonetized/omatainer · #510 another 45 commits toward producer + DJ completion
shipped.summary: The single completion PR kept moving from morning to evening, each change followed by a recorded native qualification. #510 is still open (773 files); not counted in the index.
bullets: DJ: qualified per-deck channel effects with learned selection, portable DJ FX layouts with reviewed atomic recall, and measured loopback return levels
Recovery: audio streams and watchdog signals recover after Linux CPU-budget exhaustion; stopped-controller recovery; NS7 USB transport restored after host suspend and reset on wake
Producer: reviewed Live 12 Set import (main routes, disabled return sends, complete imported Sets), recorded audio placed with compensated timing, aligned Live prints exported
Playback: large-set fades with refusal of unprimed fades and unavailable output routes; routed waveform positions aligned to delayed audio
Performance: bounded history reads, shared voice filter coefficients, and audio workers scheduled on the fastest allowed CPU class
